scripts.build: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'sh scripts/build.sh' anchor && pnpm allow-read-write
scripts.lint: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm format:check && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings' anchor
scripts.test:mollusk: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'sh scripts/test-mollusk.sh' anchor
scripts.test:unit: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo test --workspace --exclude pubkey-policy-integration-tests --locked' anchor
